description: This file defines a PHP trait EncryptionTrait used for encryption functionalities within the AWS SDK, including methods for encrypting data streams with specified cipher options, managing encryption metadata, and generating encryption streams.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a plaintext stream with specified cipher options, updates the encryption envelope with metadata, and returns an encryption stream.

methods.name: getEncryptingStream
methods.description: Generates the appropriate encryption stream based on the cipher type (e.g., GCM or others), uses the content encryption key (CEK), and returns the stream along with its associated AES name.
